entry.title: Approximating a data distribution with a polynomial
entry.summary: I had a lot of flight data from a micro drone and wanted to make a nice smooth plot... I couldn't find a ready-made solution on the internet.

entry.title: An idea for teaching GPT-4 to think, with programming problems as an example
entry.summary: I propose how GPT-4 could be improved so that it can think and iteratively get better at solving competitive programming problems.

entry.title: fopply — my program for step-by-step algebraic calculations
entry.summary: This program lets you do algebraic calculations step by step and stay in control of them. It works by smartly applying formulas to the original expression. Here is the devlog of the program together with a description of the idea behind it.

entry.title: Moving my blog to Zola and why it's better than Jekyll
entry.summary: Zola is a great static site generator. I moved my blog to it, and it inspired me to implement many cool features and to speed up the blog. This article focuses on the pros and cons of Zola as a static site generator.

entry.title: Speeding up a static website
entry.summary: My blog used to load slowly and lag a lot, even though it was a static site. Here is how I got maximum loading speed, minimal traffic and a score of 100 in Lighthouse.

entry.title: New features of this blog
entry.summary: My blog now has a bunch of features that make it easier to write unusual posts and add handy functionality for the reader. Mostly I'm just bragging, but you can also steal these features for yourself.

entry.title: Portals
entry.summary: Everything about the discoveries I made about portals; how I developed software to visualize them; what happens if you put a portal inside a portal; monoportals; a triple portal. I break your brain and space with portals.

entry.title: How I write programs
entry.summary: I show it with two examples and cover everything: collecting ideas, planning, data structures, todo lists, writing code.

entry.title: How I made graphical applications for the first time in my life: pros and cons of ImGui
entry.summary: About a tool that will change how you think about programming graphical interfaces. If your pet projects used to be limited to console utilities, now you can confidently start making graphical ones with about the same amount of effort.

entry.title: Symmetric probabilities, or Confidences
entry.summary: Ordinary probabilities give the chance that some event will happen. But how do you describe a person's confidence that an event will happen? And how do you describe that the probability increases given some event? I propose an interesting idea of "confidences", which are meant to solve this.
